title: AgnesCode Build Challenge: One Week, One Project | Bruce Yang 发布的此话题相关的动态 | 领英
description:
𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐂𝐚𝐧 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐁𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐖𝐞𝐞𝐤?
AI coding gets much more interesting when it moves beyond demos and starts helping people ship real things.

That’s the idea behind the AgnesCode Build Challenge: one week, one builder, one project. No fixed use case. Just build something useful, ambitious, or fun.

Excited to see what people choose to create, and what we learn from it. 👇
